claims.text: The dataset was obtained by collecting hotel reviews from TripAdvisor, which is the world's largest online travel site.
The HotelRec dataset contains approximately 50 million hotel reviews, which were processed to include userID, itemID, ratings, text, and date.
The dataset was specifically created for evaluating rating prediction and recommendation performance tasks.
